ideas.pitch: An automated risk and anomaly detection platform for regional transit networks using graph intelligence and LightGBM, custom-built for local infrastructure analysis.
ideas.title: Waterloo Transit Graph Intel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact technical architecture of Bito which won 1st place at the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon by combining graph intelligence and explainable machine learning.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized marketplace where student autonomous AI agents complete campus errands and micro-tasks, settling payments instantly via USDC escrow on Base.
ideas.title: Autonomous Campus Agent Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of Dispatch at the Synthesis Hackathon by implementing a functional autonomous agent marketplace with real crypto payment escrow.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite imagery monitoring platform that tracks and flags industrial land compliance and environmental changes around Ontario industrial zones.
ideas.title: EcoGrid Satellite Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs genuine hard engineering solving a complex computer vision and spatial data pipeline challenge, similar to the GeoNex-ATLAS runner-up project.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent student support and sustainability resource platform combining LangGraph, RAG, and personalized AI agents to optimize campus energy usage.
ideas.title: Campus GreenNovation Multi-Agent Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on the winning architecture of the greennovation-ai-platform by utilizing multi-agent orchestration and advanced retrieval systems.

ideas.pitch: A predictive risk dashboard using Poisson GAMs and multinomial share models to forecast algorithmic trading anomalies and financial system incidents with calibrated 90% prediction intervals.
ideas.title: AI Incident Forecaster for Local Fintech
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the rigorous quantitative modeling and statistical depth that secured 1st place for the ai-incident-forecasting project at Apart Research.
